seed_world_description: My world is an amazing place! There are such beautiful flowers there! The birds sing so sweetly! And what amazing fields! There is no evil there. Not like here... Here it's all fog, dirt, and horrible monsters. Ugh!!!!
seed_family_description: I'm not yet developed enough to know exactly what my parents do. I know that they raise livestock and then sell it. But I know for sure that we were happy. I'm so sad without them. I miss them so much! You will find a way to bring me back to them, won't you?!...
seed_occupation_description: I moved to a new place when I was a child and my intention was always to return to where I was born. My parents told me the way when I became an adult, but I got lost in the Fogs.
